name: Peak dispatch acknowledgment
acceptance: p95 < 500 ms at 10/s peak; denominator includes accepted and rejected requests

name: No duplicate vehicle assignment
acceptance: zero overlapping accepted reservations per vehicle slot

name: Fresh location evidence
acceptance: reject location older than five seconds

name: Atomic business and audit events
acceptance: accepted reservation and audit event commit or roll back together

name: Build provenance
acceptance: deploy digest must match signed or independently trusted approval manifest

name: Recover service
acceptance: restore service within 15 minutes in tested fault scenarios

name: Safe loss-of-service handling
acceptance: operator receives explicit unavailable status and escalates to approved manual procedure
